name: ═══════════════ SECONDARY GATE TELEGRAM INTERFACE ═══════════════
info:
## Secondary Gate Telegram Interface

Provides Telegram bot commands for secondary gate control.

### Commands:
- /secondary_open - Open gate (Relay 2)
- /secondary_close - Close gate (Relay 1)
- /secondary_trigger - Trigger automation (Relay 3)
- /secondary_stop - Stop gate (Relay 4)
- /secondary_light_left - Left light (Relay 5, 120s)
- /secondary_light_right - Right light (Relay 6, 120s)
- /secondary_status - Get relay status
- /secondary_help - Show help

### Dependencies:
- Requires: telegram_bot_config (from 50-telegram-interface.json)
- Uses: Same Telegram bot as other automations
